digest.component_or_area: plan review gate calibration and metrics
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen plan-v3 baseline, FP-control pool, recall-stripped clone driver, pure metrics library) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main.
The expensive ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise ~50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds.
The verdict-perturbation signal that batch replay would have measured is now produced at zero marginal LLM cost by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (change #798, merged on main).
History-mining approach for baseline reconstruction is dead due to impact_model_version bump stranding sidecar history to only ~4 plan-v3 baselines versus ~200 needed.
The pure metrics library (criterion_deltas, tkey, build_matrix, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) is golden-tested offline with no LLM dependency.
Recall contamination was addressed by copying the store and deleting all *-REVIEW_RESULT.json files under sampled tickets before driver execution.
